title: ocotea mexicana var. subsessilis
intro: Ocotea mexicana var. subsessilis, commonly known as Ocotea subsessilis, is a plant species in the family Lauraceae. This plant is native to Mexico and has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea subsessilis include reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and potentially improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Ocotea subsessilis include sesquiterpenes, primarily borneol and camphor, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
